svg.aria-label: Diagram: an ERP dashboard for a distribution company, with modules for sales, inventory, customers, suppliers, payments, commissions, and dispatch; sales charts grow, documents arrive, and a pending sales order turns paid. A coverage-gate badge shows it is covered by tests.
